title: Irony in Emojis: A Comparative Study of Human and LLM Interpretation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model to simulate a social media user of specific age groups (e.g., 'under 20', '20-34', 'over 65') and comparing the generated irony scores for emojis across these demographic prompts.
Prompting the model to simulate a social media user of a specific gender ('male' or 'female') and comparing the generated irony scores for emojis across these demographic prompts.
